jobs.title: Data Engineer – Plateforme Skywise (H/F)
jobs.description:
Leader de l’Ingénierie et des IT Services, présent dans plus de 30 pays, le groupe ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d'information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure qui vous attend au sein d’une entreprise engagée.

Description du poste

Nous recherchons un Data Engineer passionné par l’analyse et le traitement de données aéronautiques pour rejoindre nos équipes sur la plateforme Skywise. Vous contribuerez à l’amélioration continue de la maintenance prédictive et de la performance des flottes d’avions, en développant des pipelines de données robustes et en transformant les données brutes en insights exploitables.

Développer et optimiser des pipelines de données pour l’extraction, la transformation et l’analyse de séries temporelles aéronautiques (Python, SQL, Spark, Skywise)
Calculer et mettre à disposition des indicateurs de performance complexes pour la flotte aérienne
Participer à la traçabilité et à l’analyse massive des données des composants avion
Concevoir des dashboards interactifs pour visualiser et interpréter les données Skywise
Former et accompagner les équipes techniques sur les outils et bonnes pratiques (Python, SQL, Spark, Skywise)
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données traitées

Environnement technique :

Langages & Outils : Python, SQL, Spark, Pandas

Plateforme : Skywise

Données : Séries temporelles aéronautiques, maintenance prédictive, performance flotte

Autres : Visualisation de données, pipelines ETL, qualité et traçabilité des données

Qualifications

Diplômé d’une École d’ingénieurs ou d’un Master en Informatique, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle ou Aéronautique
Expérience confirmée en Data Engineering, idéalement dans un environnement aéronautique
Maîtrise des langages et outils suivants : Python, SQL, Spark, Pandas
Expérience sur la plateforme Skywise souhaitée, ou forte capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouveaux environnements data aéronautiques
Capacité à traiter et analyser des volumes massifs de données avec rigueur et précision
Bonnes compétences en communication et capacité à travailler en interface avec les équipes métiers et techniques

Informations supplémentaires

Package de rémunération attractif composé d’un fixe et d’un variable
Dispositifs de participation aux résultats de l’entreprise
De réelles perspectives d’évolution vers des trajectoires de carrière variées : management de projet ou expertise technique
Un accompagnement au développement des compétences via des certifications et des programmes de formation continue

Full-time

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the EPEX SPOT Team: Innovate, Collaborate, Thrive

Job Summary:

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and evolving EPEX SPOT's cloud-native Data Platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will combine hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership, helping deliver trusted, scalable, and AI-ready data products that support business operations, analytics, and innovation initiatives.
Acting as a technical leader within the Data Platform team, you will coach and mentor Data Engineers, drive engineering excellence, and contribute to the adoption of modern data platform capabilities such as BigQuery, Dataform, Dataplex, Dataflow, BigLake, and Vertex AI.
Working in a highly collaborative Agile environment, you will partner closely with Product Owners, Architects, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Security teams, and other platform teams to deliver business value while ensuring platform reliability, governance, and scalability.
Your scope will include:
Enterprise Data Platform development and operations
Data ingestion, processing, and analytics enablement
Data Governance and Data Product implementation
AI and Machine Learning enablement
Coaching and technical leadership within the Data Engineering team
Cross-team collaboration and alignment in an Agile environment

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead Data Engineering Delivery

Drive the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise-scale data solutions by:
Designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and data products
Building robust batch and streaming data processing solutions
Ensuring platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency
Supporting architecture decisions and technical roadmap execution
Acting as the technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges

2. Coach and Develop Data Engineers

Promote engineering excellence across the Data Platform team by:

Coaching and mentoring Data Engineers in technical and professional growth
Conducting code reviews and design reviews
Encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous learning
Supporting onboarding and development of new team members
Driving adoption of engineering standards and best practices

3.
Enable Data Governance and Self-Service Data Products

Support the delivery of trusted and governed data assets by:
Implementing governance capabilities using Google Dataplex
Supporting metadata management, lineage, cataloguing, and data quality initiatives
Ensuring compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
Enabling self-service analytics through reusable and governed data products

4. Foster Agile Collaboration and Platform Alignment

Collaborate effectively within Agile product teams and across the technology landscape:
Promoting DevOps and DataOps practices
Supporting a culture of transparency, ownership, and continuous improvement

5. Contribute to EPEX SPOT's AI and Data innovation ambitions by:

Building data foundations for analytics and AI use cases
Supporting the integration of Vertex AI and related AI services
Collaborating with Data Scientists to operationalize Machine Learning solutions

Key Requirements

Hard Skills

Google Cloud Data Platform Expertise

Strong hands-on experience with:
BigQuery
Dataform
Dataplex (catalog, lineage, data quality, tag application)
Data lake and Lakehouse implementation on GCP: Cloud Storage, external tables, BigLake, and the trade-offs between external and materialized data
Cloud Composer /Cloud Workflows
Cloud Run /Functions
IAM and Security Services
Cloud Monitoring and observability
Dataflow

Data Engineering

ELT/ETL architecture and implementation
API-based data integration
Data Contract implementation in the pipeline (assertions, quality checks, validation at build time)
Real-time and streaming architecture
Metadata management and data lineage
Data quality management
Event-driven architectures

Engineering Practices

AI-assisted engineering: proficient with GCP AI assistance (Gemini in BigQuery, Gemini Code Assist) and able to coach the data engineers on using it productively and safely
Python
SQL
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
CI/CD pipelines
Git and version control
DevOps and DataOps practices
Platform monitoring and observability
Performance optimization and cost management

Agile Delivery

Proven experience working in Agile environments

Soft Skills

Strong technical leader who drives results through expertise, influence, and a passion for developing engineering talent.
Excellent communicator and collaborator, able to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in international environments.
Combines a proactive, analytical, and continuous improvement mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a commitment to delivering high-quality business value.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 7 years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Proven experience building and operating cloud-native data platforms.
Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform data services.
Demonstrated experience coaching and mentoring Data Engineers.
Experience implementing data governance and data quality frameworks.
Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across multiple product and platform teams.
Preferred certifications:

-Google Professional Data Engineer
-Google Professional Cloud Architect
-Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
-Terraform Associate

Location:

Your work location will preferably be Paris, with no specific restriction amongst other EPEX office locations and an attractive hybrid work policy.

Who Are We?

The European Power Exchange EPEX SPOT SE operates physical short-term electricity markets in Central Western Europe, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, the Nordics and in Poland. Furthermore, EPEX SPOT newly offers local flexibility markets solution and Guarantees of Origin auctions, to foster the integration of renewable energy sources and to enhance the engagement of consumers and producers in the power market. The heart of our business is to bring together electricity supply and demand across Europe. We shape the future of the European power market by supporting decarbonization, decentralization, digitalization and contributing to the global energy transition toward a sustainable future.
At EPEX SPOT, we believe in fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where every team member can thrive. Our core values— trustful teams, innovation & agility, and customer centricity— are the foundation of everything we do. Diversity is the cornerstone of our way of working, reflected in how we face challenges and work together as unique individuals to build a stronger organization.
Our DNA is embedded in continuous improvement via constructive feedback, collaboration among colleagues and transparency culture. We believe in true leadership, supporting our vision towards the energy transition, as well as the development of our People.

Why join EPEX SPOT?

At EPEX SPOT, you'll be part of a passionate, talented, and international team dedicated to shaping the future of the European power market. Our offices and inclusive workplaces throughout Europe celebrate diversity and support our employees to unfold their full potential.
We offer a decentralized working system with an appealing Home Office and Hybrid Working setup, serving individuals’ self-determination of working conditions. Our goal-oriented, trustworthy, and flexible approach, given our multicultural environment, allows our employees’ to find a suited work-life balance. We strive for leadership development and provide the right support through an active and modern remote and hybrid teamwork.
We provide numerous career opportunities within the company and within EEX Group, granting a platform for continuous growth that puts you in the driver’s seat of your career.
We are proud of our commitment to gender equality, demonstrated by our strong performance in the gender-equality-index-at-epex-spot. Our HR strategy focuses on our People and Organization, enhancing both motivation and employability, while equally developing individuals’ skills.
Join us at EPEX SPOT and become part of a forward-thinking company where your contributions will make a significant impact, for the energy transition as well as for your career!
Discover more about us and explore career opportunities at https://www.epexspot.com/en

Benefits of working with Us:

Hybrid Working Conditions:
We offer you the flexibility of working from home or other locations for the best possible work-life balance.
Training Opportunities:
We invest in your continuous development with a dedicated annual training budget to enhance your skills through various upskilling programs and initiatives.
Career Path:
We support your career aspirations with clear pathways for advancement within the company and the EEX Group.
Internal Mobility:
We offer and support the possibility to explore new roles within the company to expand your skills and experience.
Leadership Journey:
We promote a culture of recognition and reward with the EPEX SPOT leadership journey that encourages everyone’s progression and development.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Securities and Commodity Exchanges, Services for Renewable Energy, and Utilities

jobs.title: Data Engineer/ Analist
jobs.description:
Jouw avontuur in een notendop:

Analyseren van datasets en achterhalen van de functionele vereisten
bij datamigratieprojecten.
Vertalen van bedrijfsbehoeften
naar heldere functionele oplossingen en migratiestrategieën.
Documenteren en verfijnen van functionele specificaties en procesflows
.
Samenwerken met technische teams bij de implementatie van ETL-processen, waarbij jij de kwaliteitscriteria en functionele noden
bewaakt. Hierbij maak je gebruik van onze interne ETL-tool DATAshaper
.
Opstellen en opvolgen van testscenario’s
om de correctheid van de migratie te valideren.
Fungeren als brug tussen business en IT
: je spreekt de taal van beide werelden.
Begeleiden van eindgebruikers met training, documentatie en functionele support
.

Profiel:

Sterke interesse in data en zin om technisch bij te leren (ervaring met SQL is een troef).
Begrip van datamodellering en data-analyse.
Inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en hoe deze naar IT-oplossingen vertaald kunnen worden.
Agile/Scrum methodologieën is een pluspunt.
Vloeiend in het Nederlands en Engels.

Aanbod:

Werken bij ons betekent deel uitmaken van een dynamisch en innovatief team waar jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei centraal staat. We geloven in het creëren van een stimulerende en ondersteunende werkomgeving waar jouw talenten tot hun recht komen. Bij ons krijg je de kans om je carrière naar een hoger niveau te tillen, met ruimte voor creativiteit, ontwikkeling en samenwerking. We hechten waarde aan een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven en bieden tal van voordelen om ervoor te zorgen dat jij je gewaardeerd en gemotiveerd voelt. Kom bij ons en ontdek een werkplek waar je echt het verschil kunt maken.

Profiteer van een competitief salarispakket op maat van jouw ervaring, aangevuld met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen.
We investeren in jouw groei met uitgebreide opleidings- en trainingsmogelijkheden.
Geniet van flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om te telewerken voor een optimale work-life balance.
We organiseren regelmatig teamactiviteiten om de teamgeest te versterken en de samenwerking te bevorderen.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting and Data Infrastructure and Analytics
